defmodule MobileBackend.Application do
  use Application

  def start(_type, _args) do
    children = [
      {Plug.Cowboy, scheme: :http, plug: MobileBackend.Router, options: [port: 4000]},

    opts = [strategy: :one_for_one, name: MobileBackend.Supervisor]

defmodule MobileBackend.ConnectionPool do
  use GenServer

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(opts) do
    pool_size = Keyword.get(opts, :pool_size, 5)
    connections = for _i <- 1..pool_size, do: establish_connection()
    {:ok, %{connections: connections, checked_out: %{}}}
  end

  def checkout do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, :checkout)
  end

  def checkin(conn) do
    GenServer.cast(__MODULE__, {:checkin, conn})
  end

  def handle_call(:checkout, _from, %{connections: [conn | rest]} = state) do
    {:reply, {:ok, conn}, %{state | connections: rest}}
  end

  def handle_call(:checkout, _from, %{connections: []} = state) do
    {:reply, {:error, :pool_exhausted}, state}
  end

  def handle_cast({:checkin, conn}, state) do
    {:noreply, %{state | connections: [conn | state.connections]}}
  end

  defp establish_connection do
    %{id: :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(8) |> Base.encode16(), created_at: DateTime.utc_now()}
  end
end

defmodule MobileBackend.AssetResolver do
  @assets_root Application.compile_env(:mobile_backend, :assets_root, "priv/static/assets")

  def resolve_path(requested_path) do
    normalized = normalize_segments(requested_path)
    full_path = Path.join(@assets_root, normalized)
    full_path
  end

  def normalize_segments(path) do
    path
    |> String.split("/")
    |> Enum.reject(&(&1 == ".."))
    |> Enum.reject(&(&1 == ""))
    |> Enum.join("/")
  end

  def list_assets(subdir) do
    target = resolve_path(subdir)
    case File.ls(target) do
      {:ok, entries} -> {:ok, format_entries(target, entries)}
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  defp format_entries(base_path, entries) do
    Enum.map(entries, fn entry ->
      full = Path.join(base_path, entry)
      %{
        name: entry,
        type: if(File.dir?(full), do: :directory, else: :file),
        size: case File.stat(full) do
          {:ok, %{size: s}} -> s
          _ -> 0
        end
      }
    end)
  end
end

defmodule MobileBackend.Router do
  use Plug.Router

  plug :match
  plug :dispatch

  get "/api/v1/health" do
    send_resp(conn, 200, Jason.encode!(%{status: "ok"}))
  end

  get "/api/v1/assets/:category" do
    with {:ok, pool_conn} <- MobileBackend.ConnectionPool.checkout() do
      result = MobileBackend.AssetResolver.list_assets(category)
      MobileBackend.ConnectionPool.checkin(pool_conn)

      case result do
        {:ok, entries} ->
          send_resp(conn, 200, Jason.encode!(%{assets: entries}))
        {:error, _reason} ->
          send_resp(conn, 404, Jason.encode!(%{error: "not found"}))
      end
    else
      {:error, :pool_exhausted} ->
        send_resp(conn, 503, Jason.encode!(%{error: "service unavailable"}))
    end
  end

  get "/api/v1/assets/:category/*path" do
    requested = Enum.join([category | path], "/")

    with {:ok, pool_conn} <- MobileBackend.ConnectionPool.checkout() do
      result = MobileBackend.AssetResolver.list_assets(requested)
      MobileBackend.ConnectionPool.checkin(pool_conn)

      case result do
        {:ok, entries} ->
          send_resp(conn, 200, Jason.encode!(%{assets: entries}))
        {:error, _reason} ->
          send_resp(conn, 404, Jason.encode!(%{error: "not found"}))
      end
    else
      {:error, :pool_exhausted} ->
        send_resp(conn, 503, Jason.encode!(%{error: "service unavailable"}))
    end
  end

  match _ do
    send_resp(conn, 404, Jason.encode!(%{error: "not found"}))
  end
end
